pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the Indian name for Saturday? (1 mark)
   A. Ravivaar
   B. Shanivaar
   C. Mangalvaar
   D. Guruvaar

2. In Sasankasana, where do you rest your forehead? (1 mark)
   A. On a chair
   B. On the mat
   C. On your knees
   D. On the wall

3. What does Madaraka Day teach? (1 mark)
   A. Greed
   B. Cruelty
   C. Pride
   D. Patriotism and unity

4. In which city was Parshvanath born? (1 mark)
   A. Lahore
   B. Lumbini
   C. Nairobi
   D. Varanasi

5. Where do Hindu families often grow Tulsi? (1 mark)
   A. Under the roof
   B. In the kitchen fire
   C. In a pot or raised stand in the courtyard
   D. Only in a river

6. What does Micchami Dukkadam mean? (1 mark)
   A. Happy birthday
   B. May any harm I did be forgiven
   C. Good morning
   D. Thank you for the food

7. Which pose do you start Sasankasana from? (1 mark)
   A. A handstand
   B. Standing
   C. Vajra Asana
   D. Lying down

8. Which is one of the four Purusharthas? (1 mark)
   A. Namaste
   B. Bhajan
   C. Moksha
   D. Aarti

9. Who took Ram and Lakshman to protect his forest prayers? (1 mark)
   A. Sage Valmiki
   B. Sage Vishwamitra
   C. King Shibi
   D. Guru Nanak

10. Which is a mistake about scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Making fun of another faith's holy book
   B. Listening carefully
   C. Reading with respect
   D. Keeping it clean

11. What should passengers do with rubbish? (1 mark)
   A. Leave it on the seat
   B. Drop it on the road
   C. Keep it until you find a bin
   D. Throw it out of the window

12. Which statement is true about kindness? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for rich people
   B. It is only for humans
   C. It is only for adults
   D. It includes animals and nature

13. What is the abhishek? (1 mark)
   A. Bathing the Shiva Linga with water and milk
   B. Reading a book
   C. Ringing a bell
   D. Lighting a bonfire

14. Which tradition teaches the five principles in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Only the Buddhist tradition
   B. A trade union
   C. A market
   D. Sanatan or Vedic

15. Which prayer starts with the words Twameva mata cha pita twameva? (1 mark)
   A. Gayatri Mantra
   B. Om Namah Shivaya
   C. Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva
   D. Saraswati Vandana

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe the story of Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo and its lesson. (4 marks)

17. What is Pranayam? (2 marks)

18. Explain why respect for the holy books of other faiths is important in Kenya. (5 marks)

19. What is the essence of a scripture? (2 marks)

20. On which date is Madaraka Day and what does Madaraka mean? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Shanivaar
   Shani is Saturn.

2. B — On the mat
   The forehead rests on the mat.

3. D — Patriotism and unity
   It teaches love for country.

4. D — Varanasi
   Parshvanath was born as a prince in Varanasi.

5. C — In a pot or raised stand in the courtyard
   The stand is called the Tulsi Vrindavan.

6. B — May any harm I did be forgiven
   It is a plea for forgiveness.

7. C — Vajra Asana
   You start sitting on heels.

8. C — Moksha
   The four are Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksha.

9. B — Sage Vishwamitra
   Vishwamitra asked for their help.

10. A — Making fun of another faith's holy book
   We should respect all scriptures.

11. C — Keep it until you find a bin
   Keeping the environment clean is good conduct.

12. D — It includes animals and nature
   Kindness includes all living beings.

13. A — Bathing the Shiva Linga with water and milk
   Abhishek is ritual bathing of the murti or symbol.

14. D — Sanatan or Vedic
   It is the ancient Hindu way.

15. C — Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva
   It begins with these words.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Guru Nanak chose to eat at the home of Bhai Lalo, an honest carpenter, instead of Malik Bhago's feast. The lesson is that honest work is the best way to earn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Bhai Lalo, 1 mark for choosing his home, 1 mark for honest labour, 1 mark for the lesson.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Breathing exercises.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for breathing practice.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: Kenya has people of many faiths, and respect helps us live in peace and unity. Making fun of another's holy book hurts feelings and causes conflict. Listening and learning builds understanding.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for many faiths, 1 mark for peace and unity, 1 mark for hurt feelings, 1 mark for learning, 1 mark for a clear example.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: The most important message or lesson in it.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for a correct meaning.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: 1 June; power or authority to govern.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
